description: Friends of Open Data Pakistan (ODP) publishes a CSV point inventory of public health facilities across Pakistan with about 2,370 lines: province, district, tehsil, facility name, facility type code (for example BHU, RHC, FAP), catchment population, latitude and longitude and a three-word address, first rows from Azad Jammu and Kashmir. Coverage: Pakistan, by province and tehsil; the portal record was last modified on 2023-05-02 and the collection date is not stated. Format and access: one CSV file downloadable without registration from the Open Data Pakistan portal, which also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): not stated (the portal record carries no licence field, read on 2026-09-29); cost: free. Caveats: the portal description is only the title and no licence or source organisation is given; the count of about 2,370 lines is far below the total number of health facilities in Pakistan, so coverage is partial; type codes are not defined on the page; the related Alhasan Systems health facility list is a separate catalogue record. Simulation uses: facility siting and catchment layers for healthcare accessibility, flood and earthquake exposure and emergency-response models, and a point layer to join with population and road networks. Related catalogue records: Pakistan health facilities spatial database (ALHASAN Systems, on HDX, 2017) (data-pakistan-health-facilities-alhasan-hdx); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
